message.reasoning: We need to fill the fuel tank. The tank capacity is 50 gallons. We have 10 liters. Need to convert to gallons. 1 gallon = 3.78541 liters. So 10 liters = 10 / 3.78541 ≈ 2.64172 gallons. But we want to fill up the tank fully? The user says "fill up the tank". That implies fill to full capacity. So we need to add enough fuel to reach 50 gallons. But we don't know current gallons. We only know liters. We can convert 10 liters to gallons: 2.64 gallons. So we need to add 50 - 2.64 = 47.36 gallons. But the function expects fuelAmount in gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount: 47.36. But maybe we should round to 2 decimals. Let's do 47.36.
